environment.description: Service deployed in isolated VPC (10.200.0.0/16) with no internet gateway, no NAT gateway, and no VPC peering connections. Accessible exclusively through a com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0f4a8b2c1d3e5f6a7 interface endpoint configured with a VPC endpoint policy restricting principal to arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/InternalServiceConsumer. The subnet route table (rtb-0deadbeef) contains only local routes (10.200.0.0/16 -> local) with no 0.0.0.0/0 route. Additionally, the ENI attached to the ECS task has no public IP and the security group (sg-0x9y8z7w) only permits inbound TCP 8080 from the VPC endpoint's ENI security group (sg-vpce-0a1b2c3d). NACLs on the subnet deny all traffic from non-RFC1918 sources.

config.vpc: vpc-0isolated, CIDR 10.200.0.0/16, no IGW, no NAT, no peering
config.security_group: sg-0x9y8z7w: inbound TCP 8080 from sg-vpce-0a1b2c3d only
config.nacl: deny all ingress from non-10.0.0.0/8 sources
